notes: WONDER WEAPONS: each zombies map has one. THE BONG CANNON (hospital) lobs a glowing ball of green smoke that bursts - zombies near it drop, the ones around it are stunned. THE PRESSURE GUN (THE WORKS) blasts a cone of steam that throws back and wrecks everything in front of you. Both are rare from the mystery crate (from round 3), and finishing a map's story gives you its wonder weapon. They work with the gun upgrader too.
ZOMBIES STATS: your best round, best score, zombie kills, games and finished stories are now kept for each zombies map and shown in the lobby.
FRIENDS LEADERBOARD: a new ZOMBIES tab shows the best round on each zombies map, zombie kills and stories finished for you and your friends.
